items.title: Darius Brubeck interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 29, 2024
items.q: we went on tour in South Africa as The New Brubeck Quartet. That was Dave, Chris on bass and trombone

ctx.x: My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive and I’m very pleased to have Darius Brubeck with me this morning. And you are aware, you said you’re in a studio with your brother?
Yeah, my brother Chris. In Danbury, Connecticut.
I was wondering if you and Catherine were living out of a suitcase.
